gemini-stt.description: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe via the Interactions API

gemini-3.5-transcribe.description: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe with native speaker diarization and word timestamps
gemini-3.5-transcribe.pricingNotes: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Standard paid pricing is $2.00/1M input tokens (audio, advertised $0.003/min) and $12.00/1M output tokens (advertised $0.002/min), for a combined ~$0.005/min or $0.30/hour. The hourly estimate uses 25 audio tokens/sec plus the advertised output component. AutoShow requests verbatim mode with speaker diarization and word timestamps; custom vocabulary and smart transcription are incompatible with those features and are not sent. Word timestamps may degrade transcription accuracy. Completed runs record usage-based input and output billing when returned. The reused timing estimate is provisional until an approved paid calibration under ADR-015. Thinking, caching, batch/flex/priority, free tier, taxes, and provider credits are excluded.

limits.notes: Unary audio is 1 hour; speaker diarization or word-level timestamps cap processing at 30 minutes, so AutoShow splits longer files. Uploads use the Files API up to 2 GiB. Audio input is tokenized at 25 tokens/second. Speaker diarization supports up to 8 speakers; attribution for 3 or more is experimental.
